US strikes Iran; India's Chabahar Port terminal reported undamaged

The United States has conducted strikes on sites in Iran, including near the Chabahar port. India's Ministry of External Affairs confirmed that the Chabahar Port terminal sustained no damage. The conflict has led to infrastructure damage in Kuwait and raised concerns about nuclear facilities in Iran.
